scope: Full initial population; zero continuation updates
coefficient_rule: rho / empirical mean of four scheduled unweighted gradient-norm ratios; empty contributes zero; no cap or refit
verification_rule: Exact archived v2c forward replay; weighted-gradient verification inherited from authenticated v2c evidence
sharing: One coefficient per seed/state/arm, shared across continuation streams; frozen for later 50-step branches
scoring_rule: cast live features/candidates to FP32 without renormalization; autocast and TF32 off, highest float32 matmul precision; one native matrix and transpose
scale_rule: one current-run original scale tensor; FP32 cast for head multiplication, live native connection, detached auxiliary scale; auxiliary similarities remain live
carrier_rule: one original D1 H_Synth call under unchanged D1 autocast, before head fork
target_rule: one unchanged v1 detached geometry construction and one ST candidate per arm shared by both heads
empty_rule: Native full batch; differentiable scale-disconnected auxiliary zero; cosine undefined
precision_contract: All original geometry/similarity/logit/separation tolerances unchanged; checked before calibration gradients
limitation: Initial execution coverage only; no runtime feasibility or utility claim
coverage_rule: Every frozen continuation and calibration batch at both native starting states; no filtering; stop at first demonstrated contract violation
gradient_rule: Same v2b per-exposure source/carrier/query VJPs and scale checks on live features for every nonempty batch; full encoder parameter-gradient evidence inherited from v2b/v2c
calibration_rule: Authenticate all six v2c cells and 24 coefficients; exact forward replay of all 24 calibration batches; no recalibration
diagnostic_rule: Compare FP32 head before and after gradient diagnostics on the same carrier/targets; require unchanged state and identical assigned tensors

gradient_contract.forward_reproduction: all v1 and v2a placement/native observations exactly; no_grad versus grad-enabled must reproduce
gradient_contract.fp32_reference: same live D1 carrier and cast-only FP32 H-Uniform score; one-hot candidate VJPs per eligible exposure
gradient_contract.no_post_st_normalization: enforced by candidate-to-carrier and query VJPs
